item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested","findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"Digest equality does not use hmac.compare_digest.","evidence":"release_policy.py:14 compares digests with !=.","claim_ids":["x1"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"Paths and roots are not validated as non-empty normalized relative POSIX paths.","evidence":"release_policy.py:16-18 accepts roots and paths without validation; empty changes also return True.","claim_ids":["x2","x5"]},{"finding_id":"f3","severity":"blocking","summary":"Root containment uses a raw string prefix, allowing a path such as pkg-evil/file under root pkg.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18 calls startswith(root).","claim_ids":["x3"]},{"finding_id":"f4","severity":"blocking","summary":"Rename sources are never checked, so an out-of-scope source can pass when its destination is in scope.","evidence":"release_policy.py:17-18 checks only change[\"path\"].","claim_ids":["x4"]},{"finding_id":"f5","severity":"blocking","summary":"Malformed records and unknown actions do not consistently fail closed; a missing path raises KeyError, while an unknown action with an in-scope path passes.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18 reads change[\"path\"] without checking record shape or action.","claim_ids":["x5"]}]}
